recent.name: Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
recent.description: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

recent.name: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
recent.description: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.

recent.name: Cisco BroadWorks Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
recent.description: Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

recent.name: Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability
recent.description: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606

recent.name: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
recent.description: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

recent.name: Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability
recent.description: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

recent.name: GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability
recent.description: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.

recent.name: OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability
recent.description: OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

recent.name: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability
recent.description: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

recent.name: IBM Aspera Faspex Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
recent.description: IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.

recent.name: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
recent.description: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

recent.name: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
recent.description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

cisaKev.description: CISA catalogue of vulnerabilities known to have been exploited. It is not a live incident feed.

methodology.dshield: Sensor-submitted network observations. Reports are not equivalent to confirmed criminal attacks; source classification may include scanners and benign research activity.
methodology.country: Country circles use the registered country of the network/ASN and an approximate country centroid. They do not locate people, devices, or victims.
methodology.cisaKev: Known-exploited vulnerability catalogue. A vulnerability entry does not mean a new attack happened at its publication time.
methodology.limits: This public dashboard is not exhaustive and does not provide packet-level or second-by-second global visibility.
